title: Anomaly Detection via PCA on Activation Residuals: A Lightweight Alternative to Linear Probes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Unsupervised anomaly detection without labeled misalignment data would be far more deployable. Understanding the accuracy gap motivates data collection investment. Clear practical value.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: PCA and reconstruction error are intro-ML concepts. However, activation extraction from Llama-3-8B and managing large activation matrices requires non-trivial infrastructure. Medium compute sufficient.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One model, one dataset, PCA vs supervised probe comparison. Vary number of components. Clean deliverable. Activation extraction is the main time cost. Feasible in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
